provenance.tool: WayriCAD Quick PI / 2.5D DC conductivity FEM
assumptions: Executed WayriCAD Quick PI 2.5D DC conductor solve on the exact saved source geometry; nominal 3.3 V rail with an explicit normalized 1 A controller load, not measured device performance.
Generic source A is one saved regulator output contact; load B is one saved controller supply contact. Both are ideal equipotential electrodes; other contacts have no external load.
Both saved 35 micrometre copper layers are solved together at 20 C; plated barrel thickness is assumed 25 micrometres.

The displayed field uses every finite solved FEM copper triangle and its three nodal voltage-drop values. Values vary linearly with barycentric interpolation inside each triangle; there is no smoothing, extrapolation, or zero filling outside solved copper.

The exported domain covers all 7,084 finite nondegenerate copper triangles. This run has no floating triangles. Board area outside the selected solved rail remains blank and is not a zero-voltage result.

The fixed 0..39.976681141 mV scale and summary maxima come from the full numerical solution. The small signed FEM undershoot remains in the nodal values; only the displayed color clamps at the range endpoints.

Original KiCad XY millimetre coordinates are retained. The field is bound to the exact IRCA review source hash after copper, pad and footprint-pose equivalence was checked against the original source.
No semiconductor/package/contact resistance, loaded return path, regulator dynamics, AC impedance, thermal field or measurement validation is included.
Total-drop refinement changes are 0.1507625 percent and 0.4720378 percent; current and power conservation checks passed. Local current-density peaks are not qualified.
This display-only dataset contains the solved copper triangle field; it contains no editable PCB, schematic, netlist, BOM, component identities or original CAD models.
